name: Orbit 360
description: One continuous circle around a still subject at eye level. Eight seconds is about right for a full turn, so this one costs more than the others.
prompt: Camera orbits {{subject}} in one continuous smooth circle at eye level, subject stays centred and still, consistent lighting through the turn, {{extra}}
negative_prompt: subject rotating, cuts, jump in the turn, morphing, text

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Anything else
slots.default: keep the light of the still

author: kilnry
